label: US-CA-SB354-2026 SEC. 2. / 791.22.

obligations.text: Any person who knowingly and willfully obtains information about a consumer from a licensee, surplus line insurer, reinsurer, or third-party service provider under false pretenses shall be fined not more than fifty thousand dollars ($50,000), imprisoned in a county jail for not more than six months, or both.
